researcher.plan.problem_statement: Freelance translators working with several agencies lose track of jobs, deadlines and unpaid invoices.

pain_signals.summary: A translator working with five agencies loses track of unpaid invoices.
A translator says each agency portal and PO format makes their spreadsheet messy.
A translator pays for a CAT tool but still tracks deadlines in a notebook.
A translator missed a deadline because a job was only visible in one agency portal.
A translator pays a virtual assistant to chase late agency payments.

alternatives.name: Agency payment-chasing email templates
alternatives.description: A pack of polite reminder templates and a tracker for late agency payments.
alternatives.why_fits: Uses the founder's writing and translation background.

alternatives.name: Translator PO checklist
alternatives.description: A digital checklist for checking agency purchase orders.

ideas.founder_fit_why: The founder is a translator who uses Notion.
ideas.budget_feasibility_why: Templates cost almost nothing to build.
ideas.time_feasibility_why: 10 hours a week is enough for a first version.
ideas.differentiation_why: Generic invoice tools exist, few are translator-specific.
ideas.digital_delivery_why: A template link can be delivered automatically.

market_analyst.analyse.segment: Freelance translators who work with several agencies at once
market_analyst.analyse.use_case: See every job, deadline and unpaid invoice across agencies in one place

market_size.reasoning: No retrieved source states how many freelance translators work with several agencies.

questions: Tell me about the last time you lost track of an agency invoice.
How do you keep track of jobs from different agencies today?
What have you tried to keep deadlines in one place?
What did the last missed or late payment cost you?
How often did you chase a payment last month?
Walk me through what you did the last time an agency paid late.
Would you pay 20 dollars for a Notion template that fixes this?
What tools do you already pay for in your translation work?
When did you last look for a better way to track invoices?
Who else should I talk to about this?

recruit.who: Freelance translators with three or more agency clients
where: the founder's own blog mailing list
recruit.how: Ask one person at a time, say who you are, and offer to share what you learn.

interviewer.script.outreach_draft: Hi, I am [Your name], a translator. I am learning how other freelancers keep track of agency jobs and invoices. Could I ask you about your own way of doing it in a 20-minute call? No selling, just questions.

findings.text: Two of three translators interviewed track agency invoices in a spreadsheet.
One translator lost a payment last year because an invoice was never sent.
